scope: Experimental stationary W94 desktop integration; no production campaign, M23, coverage or original remote experiments.

findings.finding: Fresh builds compile rc_sensitivity_basis_001/response.c and hysteresis_sensitivity_basis_001/response.c, but registration source hashes and final verification omit both actual helper C sources. Helper binary hashes do not bind their source. The Python module collector does not discover C files.
findings.requested_change: Record and verify identities of both helper C sources, preferably capture before compilation and verify immediately after and at completion. Preserve old runs and issue a fresh bound run.

accepted_observations: public_registration reads only config/prior_mean/prior_root/center; fixture generator is used only in native observation synthesis. Both starts are public and original prior is reused unchanged.

Compressed cost/score/full Gauss-Newton precision contains one prior term plus the single joint voltage factor. Exact begins with one original prior and processes each observation once. No posterior reuse or independent-coordinate replacement.
Q/SOC readout uses the complete joint fitted root and analytic endpoint Jacobian, preserving cross covariance; uncertainty is explicitly provisional local curvature.

Exact-node native comparison includes nonzero incoming RC and hysteresis, zero/irregular dt, polarity changes, and a first-row pre/post-step separation witness. Chunking verifies state bitwise and likelihood to tolerance.

Six targeted tests verify complete 16-coordinate feature/endpoint directional finite differences at central and off-center probes, likelihood/score/precision parity, source/order rejection, invalid last-row transaction safety, and QR failure safety.
Direct, RC and H binaries are freshly built in new temporary directories; no historical ignored .so is loaded. Direct comparator has an explicit source snapshot/build receipt.

Source/sequence ownership is synchronous caller-supplied batch ownership, not authenticated intra-batch provenance, concurrency, or crash recovery. All reported physical/certification/resource limitations are appropriately narrow.
source_binding_note: Runner/test/field identities taken from independent-run registration; documentation and missing helper C hashes captured during review. Parent may issue revised source and fresh subsequent review.
